title: Expectation of a product under an independent law
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set with decidable equality, let $\alpha_i$ be a finite set for each $i\in\iota$, and let $p_i$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha_i$ and $q_i:\alpha_i\to\mathbb{R}$. Under the independent product distribution, the expectation of the product of the coordinate functions equals the product of their expectations: $\mathbb{E}\bigl[\prod_{i\in\iota}q_i(X_i)\bigr]=\prod_{i\in\iota}\mathbb{E}_{p_i}[q_i]$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite index set $\iota$ with decidable equality
